Focus-surface mapping resolved: the focus names four surfaces that are not standalone files. 'Doctor command docs' live inside the root README.md (/doctor:setup at lines 195-196, /doctor:git standards and /doctor:git hooks at line 209, /doctor:speckit at line 555, /doctor:setup pointer at line 674); 'cli-opencode references' live in AGENTS.md line 90 (the executor-CLI-never-overrides-the-skill-route example); 'sk-git references' live in .skilled/skills/sk-code/SKILL.md and .pi/extensions/README.md, both changed by commit be234e6f94 (the sk-code-opencode → sk-code-skilled rename). All three carrier docs pass their validators cleanly.

.opencode/plugins/README.md inventory verified against the current tree with no drift: README claims 17 plugin rows plus non-source lib/ and tests/ subfolders (lines 18 and 52), and .opencode/plugins/ holds exactly 20 entries (17 plugin .js files + lib + tests + README). lib/v2-bridge.js exists and implements the documented dualPlugin(id, server) contract; 16 of 17 .js plugins import dualPlugin, and the single exception sk-vision.js is the documented symlink whose compiled build exports the same {id, setup, server} shape (README line 18).

Claim drift in .pi/extensions/pi-fast-mode-w-subagent-support/tests/README.md line 21: the README claims '7 files, 80 tests.' The file count is verified (7 .test.ts files: commands, config, extension, handoff, payload-status, precedence, propagation) but a static grep counts 68 it(/test( declarations (6+19+12+2+24+4+1). The 32-test gap candidates (it.each expansions) cannot be settled statically, and a vitest run was not executed per the no-tests research constraint — the 80 figure is therefore reported as unverified-with-likely-drift, not proven false. Method: grep -cE '^\s*(it|test)\(' per file.

The Pi fast-mode copy claim is code-consistent and the sk-vision hooks README artifact map is complete. The extension README states that when Pi discovers the extension more than once the first copy to load registers and every later copy loads as a no-op; src/index.ts lines 89-90 carry the same commitment ('the first copy to load holds the package and a later one stays silent'), and commit ddf12561fc 'register only the global extensions copy' is the .pi/settings.json packages-array registration step, so README, code and commit title agree — no contradiction. Every artifact referenced by .skilled/skills/sk-vision/hooks/README.md exists on disk: .skilled/plugins/sk-vision.js, .pi/extensions/sk-vision.ts, .devin/hooks.v1.json, vision-runtime/dist/vision-cli.js.

Research stayed read-only on the target surface: every validator invocation omitted --fix, no test suite was executed, and no file outside this research packet's lineage directory (iterations/, deltas/, gateway-owned state log) was created, modified or deleted.

Post-merge sk-doc conformance sweep of the 241 changed .md files outside specs/ found zero structural mode misses and zero P0/P1/P2 doc-code contradictions; the honest residue is two P3 advisories (SECURITY.md document_type_fallback, pi-fast tests README 80-vs-68 test-count claim).
